name: RHODEX NatCat Loss — annual economic & industry loss

ALL-LOSSES.description: One entry per calendar year, oldest first. Use the last entry for the latest confirmed figure. Both loss figures come from the same year record — one API call, two metrics.

data_source_description: DEPRECATED 2026-09-16 — see v2. This version's value_paths assumed the latest year in ALL-LOSSES always has a full-year total; live data proved that false (the in-progress current year only has quarterly figures until it completes, and ALL-LOSSES[-1] is that same in-progress record). v2 switches to the simpler latest-report endpoint and adds a total-then-quarterly fallback chain. RHODEX NatCat Loss API — Gallagher Re-sourced catastrophe loss, reported quarterly with cumulative full-year totals.
